  Vector3 modelPos,
  Matrix4 view,
  Matrix4 projection,
  Size screen,
) {

  Vector4 clip = _applyTransformation(

    view,
    projection,

  ndcY = math.clamp(ndcY, -1, 1);
  // Map to screen coordinates centered
  double sx = screen.width / 2;
  double sy = screen.height / 2;
  return Offset(sx + ndcX * (screen.width / 2), sy - ndcY * (screen.height / 2));

    double near, double far, double fovY, double aspect,
    double screenWidth, double screenHeight) {

  // ndcY = (y/d) / (tanFov / aspect)

class PerspectiveCalculator {
  /// Projects a 3D point to a 2D screen offset using perspective projection.
  /// [position] is the world-space position (after model transform).
  /// [camPos], [lookDir], [up] define the camera.
  /// [near], [far], [fovY] are the projection parameters.
  /// [aspect] is screenWidth / screenHeight.
  /// [screenWidth], [screenHeight] are the canvas size.
  Offset toOffset(Vector3 position,
      Vector3 camPos, Vector3 lookDir, Vector3 up,
      double near, double far, double fovY, double aspect,
      double screenWidth, double screenHeight) {
    // 1. Transform to view space (remove forward component)
    Vector3 vec = position.sub(camPos);
    double d = vec.dot(lookDir); // distance along look direction
    vec = vec.subtract(lookDir.scale(d)); // remove forward component

    // 2. Get right and up vectors in view space
    Vector3 right = Vector3.fromCoordinates(
      (Vector3.right.cross(lookDir).normalize()).x, // Actually compute properly
      (Vector3.right.cross(lookDir).normalize()).y,
      0.0
    );
    // Simpler: use cross(up, lookDir)
    Vector3 right2 = Vector3.fromCoordinates(
      (up.cross(lookDir).normalize()).x,
      (up.cross(lookDir).normalize()).y,
      0.0
    );
    Vector3 up2 = Vector3.up.subtract(lookDir.dot(Vector3.up) * lookDir).normalize();

    double uvX = vec.dot(right2);
    double uvY = vec.dot(up2);

    // 3. Map to NDC
    double tanFov = math.tan(fovY / 2.0);
    // ndcX = uvX / (d * tanFov)
    double ndcX = (uvX / d) / tanFov;
    // ndcY = uvY / (d * tanFov / aspect)
    double ndcY = (uvY / d) / (tanFov / aspect);

    // Depth
    double ndcZ = (2 * d - near - far) / (far - near);
    ndcZ = math.clamp(ndcZ, -1.0, 1.0); // Clip out-of-frustum

    // 4. Map to screen
    double sx = screenWidth / 2.0;
    double sy = screenHeight / 2.0;
    double scrX = sx + ndcX * (screenWidth / 2.0);
    double scrY = sy - ndcY * (screenHeight / 2.0); // Flip Y for canvas

    return Offset(scrX, scrY);
  }
}
